failure_summary.description: The agent repeated a hotel base search instead of filtering the compatible cached results with the newly supplied room-count and budget constraints.

patch.reasoning: The skill already describes cache-aware filtering generally, but this failure shows that answers to follow-up questions about supported hotel constraints were still treated as new searches. Explicitly identify those answers as filter updates and show the combined filter call.

edits.content: - When the user answers a follow-up about supported constraints on an already searched domain—such as hotel room count or budget—treat the answer as a constraint update if a compatible cached result covers the same location and dates. Retrieve that result by its exact key and pass all newly supplied constraints together to the matching filter (for example, `filter_hotels(prior_results=hotels, num_rooms=..., budget=...)`); do not repeat the base search.
